caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic spoon positioned horizontally across the center of a plain, beige background. The spoon is rendered in shades of grey and silver, showing reflective highlights in blue-white tones on both the handle and bowl. The handle is squared at the end and slightly widens, with an inscription that reads "363" in a cursive style. The edges of the spoon are outlined in dark lines to emphasize its form, and a subtle shadow in dull green and grey appears beneath and to the left of the spoon, indicating a light source from the upper right. No other objects or decorative elements are present, and the overall composition is minimalistic, with the spoon as the only object centrally placed against the empty background.
title: Silver Spoon
